selection: the placeholder views of the table and the calculation editor
description: The table editor and the calculation editor as placeholder views with a title and a phrase selector, the table editor also with the related columns of each column tier, so that the steps of docs/table_creation.md can link to them before the editors are done. This file is imported as the last step of the db setup, so that no database id of a tested view or component moves.
